parts.stem:
A copper wire of length $4.0\,\mathrm{m}$ has a uniform cross-sectional area of $4.5\times10^{-7}\,\mathrm{m^2}$.

A tensile force of $18\,\mathrm{N}$ is applied to the wire. This causes the wire to extend by $1.4\,\mathrm{mm}$ up to its limit of proportionality.
parts.text:
Calculate the Young modulus of the wire.
